# Yin and Yang

Yin and Yang provides high-contrast dark and light modes for a stark, highly readable interface. Style Settings adjusts the base hue and saturation, and its recorded description points to the Hider plugin for hiding UI elements to reach a cleaner, minimal workspace.

![Yin and Yang screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chetachiezikeuzor/Yin-and-Yang-Theme/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Yin and Yang"
    author: "chetachiezikeuzor"
    repo:   "chetachiezikeuzor/Yin-and-Yang-Theme"
    slug:   "yin-and-yang"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/yin-and-yang"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/chetachiezikeuzor/Yin-and-Yang-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chetachiezikeuzor/Yin-and-Yang-Theme/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png"

    modes:  ["dark", "light"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Switch between high-contrast dark and light modes for a stark, highly readable interface. Customize base hue and saturation via Style Settings and hide UI elements with Hider to create a cleaner, minimal workspace."
}
```
